subject.title: fix(status): LINE /status intermittent no-response — fallback, timeout, and retry hardening

question: Should the shared `/status` slash-command path impose a fixed 10-second render deadline across all channels, or should this PR land retry and generic error containment without that global deadline?
rationale: The reported symptom is LINE-specific, but the modified function is the common channel-command boundary; source review cannot select a permanent cross-channel latency contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land without global deadline
options.body: Keep retry-on-rejection and generic error containment, and handle channel-specific timing separately if evidence requires it.

options.title: Approve shared deadline
options.body: Adopt 10 seconds as the cross-channel slash-command status contract and require representative live proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Land without global deadline
recommendation.body: Keep retry-on-rejection and generic error containment, and handle channel-specific timing separately if evidence requires it.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently introduced and maintained the exact shared command module where the deadline is added.
